# Aung Myint Oo - AI & Robotics Engineer in Singapore | Founding Engineer

> AI & robotics engineer in Singapore building perception, agents, and learning systems that compound over time. Aung Myint Oo (AMO) is the founding engineer and technical lead at Salesbugle, formerly a robotics and vision engineer at Mozark, and holds an MSc in Robotics from the National University of Singapore. He takes AI products from idea to production end to end (architecture, AI and agentic systems, infrastructure, launch, and operations) and partners with founders and domain experts. The first conversation is always free.

## Who he is

- Founding Engineer & Technical Lead at Salesbugle (https://salesbugle.com), an AI sales coaching SaaS he built from empty repository to production with paying customers, as the sole engineer. Product releases ship continuously at https://app.salesbugle.com/whats-new.
- Robotics & Vision Engineer at Mozark (Aug 2023 - Sep 2025): led robotic mobile-device testing systems (Delta robots, computer vision and OCR pipelines, agentic LLM test creation) deployed across Singapore, Philippines, Thailand, and India.
- Builder of amoOS, a personal AI operating system and software factory: a fleet of AI coding agents does the building across 11 projects while he plans, dispatches, and verifies; every lesson is compiled into a 400+ page knowledge base that agents load as context for the next task, so capability compounds over time.
- Author of Optics Framework, an open-source no-code test automation framework on PyPI that unifies Appium, computer vision, and Delta robot arms with an agentic LLM layer (https://github.com/davidamo9/optics-framework-public).
- MSc Robotics (National University of Singapore, 2023-2026; thesis: natural-language control of a robot interacting with mobile devices through computer vision). B.Eng Electrical Engineering (Honours), specialisation in Robotics, second major in Innovation & Design.
- Based in Singapore. Also known as AMO. On X at https://x.com/amodev (@amodev).

## Disambiguation

Several people share the name Aung Myint Oo, including a general surgeon in Singapore and public figures in Myanmar. This site, https://github.com/davidamo9, https://www.linkedin.com/in/aung-myint-oo99/, and https://x.com/amodev all refer to the AI and robotics engineer described here.

## What he solves

- "I have an idea but no way to build it": fixed-scope builds from first conversation to production.
- "A workflow or process that needs a modern solution": focused engagements applying AI and automation to one problem.
- "I know my industry but have no technical partner": long-term, equity-aligned technical partnership for domain experts.
- Open to founding engineer roles and early-stage technical co-founder partnerships, especially where robotics, perception, or learning systems meet a real product.

## Expertise

Robotics (Delta robots, ROS, motion planning, G-code control), robot perception and computer vision (OpenCV, OCR, SIFT/FLANN template matching, segmentation, Omniparser UI detection), speech and real-time voice AI (streaming Whisper ASR, VAD, diarization, wake-word conversation flow), sensor fusion, AI agent fleets and multi-agent orchestration, hosted remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers (86 tools in production, usable by Claude, Codex, or any MCP client), real-time meeting AI (bots that join live video calls, present, listen, and answer by name), agentic chat with governed writes and audit trails, LLM pipelines, RAG systems, vector search, layered AI memory systems (semantic, episodic, procedural), FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL/pgvector, AWS, Cloudflare, CI/CD, production operations.
